sources: https://www.camplife.com/394/reservation/step1 (CampLife booking API: reservation session and site records for campground 394, read 2026-10-21)

values.note: Free permit booked through the District's CampLife reservation system (a free account is needed, and availability shows only once logged in). Up to 7 nights per reservation; no more than two reservations at a time or in a 30-day period. Up to 8 people and 2 vehicles per site.

booking.source: https://nwfwater.com/lands/recreation/area/escambia-river/williams-lake/ ('reservation-only camping', 'Each campsite can hold a maximum of eight people and two vehicles', 'Reserve' link to camplife.com/394) + https://nwfwater.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/Step-by-Step-Instructions-on-How-to-Make-A-Camping-Reservation.pdf ('A reservation can be made for up to seven (7) nights. No more than two (2) reservations can be booked at a time or in a 30 day period'), read 2026-10-21

hookups.source: https://nwfwater.com/lands/recreation/area/escambia-river/williams-lake/ ('The campsites do not have power, water or waste disposal hookups.') + CampLife site records for campground 394 ('No Hookup. RV and Tent sites'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Three back-in sites taking motorhomes, fifth wheels, truck campers, vans, fold-downs and tents. CampLife lists every site as 50 ft, which looks like a default rather than a measured length, so no max rig length is recorded.

sites.source: CampLife session for campground 394 (Sites 1-3 'Back-in', equipment MOTORHOME, 5TH WHEEL, TRUCK CAMPER, VAN, FOLDDOWN, TENT; 'No Hookup. RV and Tent sites with picnic table, fire ring, pedestal grill and a portable toilet.'), read 2026-10-21

note: Northwest Florida Water Management District recreation area by an Escambia River oxbow near Jay, about 40 miles northeast of Pensacola. Picnic tables, pedestal grills, fire rings, portable toilet, boat launch with trailer parking. Site length is not published - primitive sites on unpaved access; check the site diagram before bringing a big rig. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on the District page and its CampLife records: reservation-only RV/tent sites with no hookups, 7-night limit, free. Added 3 back-in sites (CampLife). No storm-closure banner on the page and not on the District's closures list (2026-10-21). Note trimmed of the hookup/booking facts the fields carry. Not stated: real max rig length, season, potable water.
flags: Availability on CampLife is shown only to a logged-in (free) account; camping is free, so no rate is hidden.
